chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Mithammi, from Aban, from Abu al-Abbas al-Baqbaq, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: "Whoever takes possession of an inheritance before it is divided, it is for him."

key_terms.يُقْسَمَ: It is divided (formal distribution of estate)

ai.seo_question: What is the legal status of taking possession of inheritance before its formal division?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the legal status of pre-division possession in inheritance, affirming that taking one's share before formal partition (*qismah*) does not invalidate ownership. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling underscores the principle that heirs acquire rights to specific assets upon the death of the deceased, even prior to the physical distribution of the estate. It serves as a practical guideline for resolving disputes over interim possession among co-heirs.
